project.name: Student Management Microservices (Circuit Breaker, Retry, Saga, Kafka)
project.description: Five independent Spring Boot microservices (api-gateway, student, course, enrollment, notification), each backend owning its own MySQL database. Cross-service validation for a new enrollment is coordinated with a choreography-based Saga over Kafka. Two resilience patterns from the Resilience4j library protect the places most likely to fail in real systems: Retry around every Kafka publish, and Circuit Breaker around the two places this system makes a plain synchronous HTTP call (enrollment-service's cross-service detail lookup, and notification-service's simulated external email/SMS gateway).
